questions.stem: Clonidine is used to prevent diarrhea in diabetic patients with autonomic neuropathy because
questions.stemHtml: Clonidine is used to prevent diarrhea in diabetic patients with autonomic neuropathy because

options.label: A
options.text: Stimulation of a1 receptors in the GI tract may increase absorption of sodium chloride and fluid and increase secretion of bicarbonate

options.label: B
options.text: Stimulation of a1 receptors in the GI tract may increase absorption of sodium chloride and fluid and inhibit secretion of bicarbonate

options.label: C
options.text: Stimulation of a2 receptors in the GI tract may increase absorption of sodium chloride and fluid and reduce secretion of bicarbonate

options.label: D
options.text: Inhibition of Imidazoline receptors in the GI tract may increase absorption of sodium chloride and fluid and inhibit secretion of bicarbonate
